t: Linux, Python, Vim & Git (LPvg) Your Minimum Tech Toolkit for Life
s: The article champions Linux, Python, Vim, and Git (LPvg) as a foundational toolkit for lifelong technological empowerment. It introduces Nix as a revolutionary system configuration and environment sharing tool, complementing LPvg and Python web development tools like FastHTML and HTMX.
sub: LPvg as a core, future-proof technical toolkit.
Nix for declarative environment management and reproducibility across platforms.
FastHTML and HTMX for Pythonic, simplified web development.
The historical context of Unix portability and open-source liberation.
